edge_cases: A qualifying substring is at least five characters long. Substrings are counted by position, so identical text at different positions counts more than once.
input_semantics: One parameter, word, a string of lowercase English letters.
load_bearing: Every character of a qualifying substring is a vowel, and all five vowels appear within it.
output_semantics: A single integer: the number of qualifying substrings.
required_operation: Count the contiguous substrings of a string that consist only of vowels and contain every one of the five vowels at least once, and report that count.
source_basis: The question title and the boilerplate method name, both from this project's own bank. No sentence is copied from any external problem statement.
title: Count Vowel Substrings of a String
